label: Mixed-flavour leakage totals
subgoals: Multiply each flavour's cell count by its per-cell leakage
Divide the low-Vt leakage by the ratio for high-Vt cells
Sum the flavours and find which dominates

label: Leakage recovery
subgoals: Count the cells swapped as a fraction of the total
Multiply by one minus one over the leakage ratio
Rely on identical footprints so swaps need no re-routing

label: Spending slack on a path
subgoals: Divide the slack by the per-swap delay penalty
Cap the number of swaps at the gates on the path
Order swaps by leakage saved per unit of slack across shared paths
